text:
Cal (Product): @channel heads-up: tomorrow 09:30 PT we GA 'Cost-Aware Fallbacks' for the hosted API. It automatically routes requests to cost-optimized model variants (quantized or smaller variants) when latency/cost policies allow, and falls back to a higher-fidelity model on demand. Opt-in via header in the first phase. Short rollout notes below.

Priya (Eng): Nice. How do clients opt in? Any payload changes?

Cal (Product): Clients can opt-in with header `X-Cost-Aware: enabled` or query `?cost_aware=1`. Optional request param `cost_profile` accepts `balanced|latency|aggressive` (default `balanced`). Example: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
     -H "X-Cost-Aware: enabled" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"model":"mosaicx","input":"Summarize this doc","cost_profile":"balanced"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Hannah (ML): Note: fallback uses quantized-mosaicx-q4 and mosaicx-small variants. We ran evals across 15 prompt sets: balanced keeps semantic parity >98% for short summaries; aggressive saves ~12-18% compute but increases small-noun-recall edge cases. Optimize will surface regressions and an automated quality rollback if drift >1.2x.

Gabe (SRE): Deploy plan: canary us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1, 25m windows. Abort if p95 latency increases >30% for legacy path, or error rate delta >1.5x. If the bridge path misbehaves we auto-route affected keys to legacy model for 10m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/cost-aware-ga (pinned in #eng-oncall).

Priya (Eng): How does routing decision surface in logs/console?

Cal (Product): Console panels: per-key cost-savings, fallback counts, model-variant hit rate, and quality alerts. We'll add a short annotation when customers trigger automatic fidelity-preserve fallbacks.

Luis (Docs): Docs PR merged: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4991 — migration guide, examples (node/python), and FAQ for choosing `cost_profile`. I'll publish at deploy and include a note for billing.

Gabe (SRE): Billing note: savings reported as Token Cost Units; customers see a breakdown of which variant served each request in the Usage UI. Enterprise can pin keys to never use aggressive fallbacks via account settings.

Hannah (ML): Quality hooks enabled: function-call fidelity, hallucination rate, and semantic-similarity checks. Alert if hallucination delta >0.5% vs baseline.

DeployBot: Scheduled job ca-199123. Canary starts 2026-03-30T16:30:00Z. Logs will post here.

Gabe (SRE): Canary +6m: p50 130ms, p95 420ms, errors flat. Proceeding to next region. Monitoring fallback ratio and quality hooks closely.

Priya (Eng): SDKs will expose `costAware: true` and `costProfile: 'balanced'` flags in next patch.

Cal (Product): Action items: Eng/SRE watch canary and be ready to rollback first 20m; Docs publish migration note; ML watch quality hooks. We'll send a customer email in 24h with sample savings and guidance.

DeployBot: Canary complete: succeeded. Regional rollout in progress.

Gabe (SRE): Global rollout complete for initial regions. No aborts. Closing monitoring window in 15m.

Cal (Product): Thanks team. We'll post a GA recap with early savings, fallback rates, and any follow-ups in 48h. If anyone spots regressions tag @Gabe.

Priya (Eng): :rocket:
